caveat: This tracks changes in OpenRouter's published ZDR-eligibility list only. It cannot show whether any provider actually retains or deletes data; the flag is a claim, and this feed records when the claim appears, moves or disappears. History before the first live snapshot comes from Internet Archive captures at irregular times, so each change is dated to the window between two observations, not an exact moment. Archived-catalog notes rest on Wayback captures whose completeness is unverified; they record observations, not causes. Scope is one router (OpenRouter). Not affiliated with OpenRouter.
